messages:
sam: Heads-up: ops wants to unpin runtime 4.1 -> 4.2 and SDK 2.x -> 3.0 for hosted on Tue 02:00 UTC. Scheduling in deploybot now; I spotted a failing customer regression in APAC embeddings yesterday. tagging @tara @nisha to check.

deploy-bot: Proposed unpin: runtime-4.1->4.2, sdk-2.x->3.0. Window: 2026-05-20T02:00Z. To hold: `/deploybot hold unpin 1766823456 reason:\"apac-embed-regress\" approvers:@tara`

tara: Please don't proceed. APAC-prod has a steady stream of low-confidence embeddings for region=ap-northeast. Reproducer in staging: `curl -X POST /embeddings -d '{"text":"long technical doc"}'` returns drifted vectors vs baseline.

nisha: I ran a quick diff: quantized kernel path in runtime-4.2 yields slight fp rounding that cascades during cache normalization. It's reproducible on long docs >2k tokens.

kevin: if that's the case we should region-pin APAC to runtime-4.1 until we ship a precision-tweak. We can still unpin for other regions.

sam: Agreed. Can deploybot do a region-scoped pin? I don't want to block global rollout.

deploy-bot: Region pinning supported. Command: `/deploybot pin runtime runtime-4.1 scope:region=ap-northeast duration:72h reason:\"regress-apac-embeds\" approvers:@tara`

tara: Placed a hold on the global unpin. Also initiated region pin for ap-northeast for 72h. Hold expires in 24h.

nisha: I'll prepare a narrow hotfix branch that reverts the kernel selection heuristic for quant paths. ETA 8h. If that lands, we can lift the hold and roll 4.2 everywhere.

kevin: In parallel, ops will spin up a fallback pool pinned to 4.1 and route VIP traffic for impacted customers there. Runbook step: update routing tag `runtime_override=4.1` on the customer VIPs.

sam: Please collect canary results after patch candidate. Use script: `./infra/canary/compare_embeddings.sh --region ap-northeast --model text-embed-v2` and paste summary here. Keep it brief.

nisha: Will run after build. Quick heads-up logs show: ```
WARN embedding_norm drift=0.12 threshold=0.05
TRACE kernel: quant_conv_v2 selected over quant_conv_v1 at seq=2048
```

ops-bot: Alert: route-change planned for customer VIP CUST-889 at 2026-05-18T09:00Z — action by kevin.

kevin: Routing change scheduled, will coordinate with customer success for notice.

sam: If hotfix misses the hold window, plan B: (1) unpin non-APAC regions, (2) leave APAC pinned to 4.1 and serve via fallback pool, (3) notify customers and open postmortem.

tara: +1. I'll draft release note fragment: "Unpin paused for APAC due to embeddings regression; global unpin proceeds with APAC region pinned to runtime-4.1 until remediation."

nisha: Test run ongoing. If we see >0.02 avg cosine drift vs baseline on long docs, we won't lift the hold. Posting results in ~6h.

sam: Thanks. Marking this thread as decision source. If anyone else flags regression in other regions call it out here. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-501 (apac-embed-drift).
